====History====
====={{aniseries|RS}}=====
Lucy appeared in ''[[AG158|Queen of the Serpentine!]]''. Before battling {{Ash}}, she rescued his {{AP|Pikachu}} from {{TRT}} with her {{TP|Lucy|Seviper}}, defeating [[Jessie's Seviper|Jessie's own Seviper]] in the process.

During the battle, Ash started off by using his {{AP|Donphan}} against Seviper. For a while, Lucy seemed to have the upper hand despite the [[type]] disadvantage. However, Ash managed to turn the tables on the Fang Snake Pokémon by using Donphan's {{m|Rollout}} to counter Seviper's {{m|Flamethrower}}, knocking it out.

Lucy then sent out her {{p|Milotic}}, which easily defeated Donphan with a single {{m|Hydro Pump}} attack. Left with no other choice, Ash decided to use {{AP|Pikachu}}. However, again, despite the type disadvantage, Lucy almost managed to defeat the {{type|Electric}} with a barrage of Hydro Pumps and {{m|Twister}}s. She even used Milotic's {{status|paralysis|paralyzed state}} and had it strike Pikachu with a powered up {{m|Facade}}. Ash finally managed to defeat Milotic and win the match after he had Pikachu jump inside one of Milotic's Twisters to land a spinning {{m|Volt Tackle}}, earning him the [[Symbol|Luck Symbol]].

====={{aniseries|DP}}=====
She reappeared in a flashback in ''[[DP128|A Pyramiding Rage!]]''.

====Character====
In the {{pkmn|animated series}}, Lucy is very different from her game incarnation personality-wise, more often appearing to show a gentler side. She is shown to have romantic feelings towards {{an|Brock}}, but due to her shyness and Brock being pulled away from her during his moments of flirting with her, she was never able to confess her feelings towards him. She allowed {{Ash}} to challenge her, even though the [[Battle Pike]] was closed that particular day, and also congratulated him on his victory. Lucy also doesn't tend to speak much, with her assistant [[Barbara]] having to speak for her most of the time.

Lucy has a preference for serpentine Pokémon and uses their tails as the perfect offensive strategy. [[Scott]] revealed that Lucy never taught her Pokémon defensive moves. Instead, she allows her Pokémon to take direct attacks from the opponent before retaliating with her own. She also keeps a lot of Pokémon with squinted eyes at her home, explaining her affection towards Brock, who also has such eyes.
